title: From SQL to Knowledge Graphs: An LLM-Driven Multi-Agent Approach with Data Schema Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2608.26117v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: RDBMS (Relational Database Management System) databases face several limitations, including slow execution with multi-hop queries and a lack of explainability by graphical interpretations. In contrast, Graph database offers a more intuitive and efficient data schema that performs faster execution on large datasets. Most existing RDBMS conversion pipelines focus on running traditional loading commands and relying on Cypher queries. However, the efficiency of using an LLM to generate an effective graph data schema, significantly reducing the ambiguity of the graph database, remains underexplored in the current research literature. This paper presents a novel algorithm that bridges RDBMS and graph database by using a novel LLM-powered ETL agent to standardize table and column names before saving them to the Data Mart. translated_title: 从SQL到知识图谱：一种带有数据模式改进的LLM驱动的多智能体方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26117v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：关系数据库管理系统（RDBMS）数据库面临若干限制，包括多跳查询执行缓慢以及缺乏图形化解释的可解释性。相比之下，图数据库提供了一种更直观、更高效的数据模式，能在大型数据集上实现更快的执行速度。大多数现有的RDBMS转换流程侧重于运行传统的加载命令并依赖Cypher查询。然而，使用LLM生成有效的图数据模式，以显著减少图数据库的模糊性，这一效率在当前研究文献中仍未得到充分探索。本文提出了一种新颖算法，通过使用一种新型的LLM驱动的ETL代理来标准化表和列名，然后将其保存到数据仓库中，从而桥接RDBMS和图数据库。一个多智能体系统在ETL、分析器和图代理之间生成循环讨论，以优化最终设计。
tldr: 本文提出了一种LLM驱动的多智能体方法，通过标准化数据模式并优化图设计，将关系数据库高效转换为知识图谱，从而提升查询速度和可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM-driven multi-agent approach that efficiently converts relational databases into knowledge graphs by standardizing data schemas and optimizing graph design, thereby improving query speed and explainability.
